cli.new_type: New type "{type}" — types already in use: {others}
cli.not_found: No such entry, or its copy is missing: {id}
cli.types_footer: — {count} type(s) in use. Types are an open set; add one only when the existing ones truly do not fit.
cli.open_note: — the reader has exactly one window; projects switch via the tabs on top
cli.server_not_ready: Server is not ready — the file was archived, but the reader did not open.
cli.scan_summary: {candidates} candidate(s) → {entries} entry point(s) ({inner} inner page(s)) → {added} added, {skipped} skipped
cli.demo_done: Loaded {count} sample document(s). Run `tabless open --all` to look at them.
cli.demo_missing: Sample files are missing from this installation: {path}
cli.err_deps_too_big: Dependency closure is {size}MB, over the {limit}MB ceiling — the closure probably went wrong: {path}
help.prog: A local shelf and reader for the HTML your coding agent writes.
help.add: Archive an HTML file and open it in the reader
help.add.project: which project it belongs to (inferred from the path when omitted)
help.add.type: report / prototype / doc / eval … an open set; run `tabless types` first and reuse what fits
help.add.title: explicit title (taken from <title>/<h1> when omitted)
help.add.source: where it came from, e.g. agent / wechat:Alice / manual
help.add.cwd: working directory, used as a second hint when inferring the project
help.add.no_open: archive only, do not open the reader
help.scan: Bulk-import HTML that is already lying around
help.scan.roots: directories to scan (defaults to the agent scratchpad under the temp directory)
help.scan.type: type to file the whole batch under
help.live: Register a live prototype (stores a pointer, never a copy)
help.live.hint: how to start it, e.g. run `npm run dev` in web/ first
help.list: List what is in the library
help.types: List the types in use (worth a glance before `add`)
help.retype: Refile an entry under a different type; the copy on disk moves too
help.open.project: which project to show (defaults to the most recently updated one)
help.where: Print where the library and its config live
help.demo: Load a few sample documents so you can see what the reader looks like
help.server: Run the local reader service in the foreground
ui.title: tabless
ui.group_title: Switch grouping between date and type (shortcut: g)
ui.filter_unread_title: Show only what you have not opened yet (shortcut: u)
ui.filter_type_title: {name} · {count} — Ctrl-click to pick more than one
ui.star_title: Star — pins across every type (shortcut: p)
ui.no_disk_path: This entry has no path on disk
live.desc: This prototype is still being changed, so tabless keeps a pointer instead of a copy — a snapshot would go stale, and would most likely be broken on arrival.
live.note: If the service isn't running you'll get a blank page. Starting it is not tabless's job.
